title: MoE Circuit Tracer
tagline: Traces which experts fire, and why, inside mixture-of-experts models.
description: Mixture-of-experts layers route each token to a handful of experts, but the routing decision is a black box. MoE Circuit Tracer instruments the forward pass to record per-token routing, then attributes downstream behavior back to specific experts — building a circuit-level map of which subnetworks own which behaviors.

The goal is mechanistic: not "expert 7 is active" but "expert 7 implements this feature, and here is the causal trace proving it." Pre-print stage; the attribution method holds up on small open models, and the tooling is built to scale to larger checkpoints once compute is available.

paper.title: Circuit-Level Attribution of Expert Routing in Mixture-of-Experts Language Models
paper.abstract: We introduce a tracing harness that records per-token expert routing during the forward pass of mixture-of-experts models and attributes downstream behavior to individual experts via causal interventions. On small open checkpoints, the method recovers sparse, behavior-specific circuits; we release the tooling and discuss scaling limits imposed by compute access.
